newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks seen rising in thin trading.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks seen rising in thin trading.

text.p: Shares on the Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) may rise slightly in thin trading when the market reopens following a three-day holiday to mark the Moslem Eid al-Adha festival, brokers said on Sunday.

"We have some buying orders for underpriced blue chips. The share prices are most attractive at the moment," said Golam Sarwar of Mahbub Morshed and Company. But, he said, volumes could be thin as holidays outside Dhaka sideline many investors. The DSE all-share price index closed up 2.24 points, or 0.29 percent, at 1,113.9 on turnover of 34.1 million taka on the last trading day last Wednesday.
